comment: The demo user has no data for the optional profile claims middle_name, nickname, profile, picture, website, gender, birthdate, zoneinfo and locale. Claims without data are omitted, as OpenID Connect Core 5.4 allows.
acr is not supported, so the 'SHOULD return acr' recommendation does not apply. The request itself succeeds.
The claims request parameter is not supported (claims_parameter_supported is false in discovery). With only the openid scope, name is correctly not released.
